name: Wulfgang von Brandt
source:
A beast hunter and warlock, he is a glutton for fame, fortune, and Catrin's love. With a sharp gaze and an obsession with both Catrin and the Silver Devil, he's all about the glory of the hunt. 

[From [url=https://madame-photon.itch.io/snow-angel-and-silver-devil]Itch.io[/url]]
